verdict.rationale: Gitea's own site says it syncs "seamlessly with tools like Slack, Discord, MS Teams, Lark, and more", naming exactly the story's chat targets. It also advertises webhooks for extending functionality, so chat integration is a first-party capability. missing for 10: in-depth docs on which repository and pull request events can be sent and how chat webhooks are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the chat notifications working.
